INSERT INTO communities 
                (id, name, img_url, address, chain, merkle_root, last_updated_time, merkle_proofs, holder_count)
            VALUES 
                ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
            ON CONFLICT (id) 
            DO UPDATE SET 
                merkle_root = $6,
                last_updated_time = $7,
                merkle_proofs = $8,
                holder_count = $9
